name: MyCoach Pro
description: The My Coach Pro MCP server gives coaches and analysts natural-language access to their My Coach Pro account. It exposes read-only tools to search players, teams, calendars, and notes, and to export performance analysis variables, reports, and athlete-monitoring data scoped to the teams a user can access. Scouting tools (players, teams, shortlists) are available to users with scouting access. All access is authenticated per-user via OAuth, so results respect each user's existing permissions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add MyCoach Pro to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add MyCoach Pro to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.mycoachpro.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the MyCoach Pro MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: MyCoach Pro provides these MCP tools: export_analysis_variables_v2, export_reports, get_calendar, get_current_players, list_event_types, list_teams, list_variables_in_use, render_report, search_notes, search_players, search_scouting_teams, and search_shortlists.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to MyCoach Pro?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to MyCoach Pro in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does MyCoach Pro MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: MyCoach Pro requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
MyCoach Pro is developed by MyCoach Pro. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
